_doc: N7RT runtime image validated in S1.2 and distributed in the student SDK. 'stm32lab sdk' takes the runtime region of the runtime build (firmware/stm32_h753_bringup, preset runtime: the runtime sources are in the instructor repository only, never in the student repository) and refuses it unless its SHA-256, size and build id are exactly these. Bump this file only with new hardware evidence.
toolchain: GNU Tools for STM32 14.3.1 (STM32Cube bundle 14.3.1+st.2), CMake preset runtime
